lib.title: Library
lib.empty.title: Nothing here yet
lib.empty.body: Episodes you watch show up here to continue later.
lib.sort.title: Title
lib.list_empty.title: Nothing in {status}
lib.list_empty.body: Use "Add to list" on a title page, or import a MAL / AniList export in Settings > Accounts.
lib.fav_empty.title: No favorites yet
lib.fav_empty.body: Tap the heart on a title or a character to keep it here.
lists.not_connected: Connect AniList or MAL in Settings > Accounts to sync your lists. History stays on this PC and syncs with your phone over Tatakai Link.
lists.local_hint: Saved on this PC. Connect AniList or MAL to keep it in your account.
lists.fav.char_hint: Connect AniList to also keep this favorite on your profile.
lists.conflicts.title: Sync conflicts
accounts.hint: Tatakai has no account of its own: your identity is your AniList and / or MyAnimeList account. Lists, progress, favorites and scores live there.
accounts.disconnect_body: The token is deleted from this PC and the lists that came from this account stop showing. Your account itself is not touched.
accounts.waiting_browser: Finish signing in to {service} in your browser…
accounts.conflicts_hint: Choose which version to keep, per title or for all.
accounts.import_hint: MyAnimeList XML export, AniList JSON or a Tatakai list file. Entries are queued for your connected accounts.
accounts.export_hint: Saved to your Downloads folder. The JSON file can be imported again.
accounts.auto_progress_hint: When you finish an episode, its progress goes to your lists (and a new series is added as Watching).
accounts.progress_at: Count an episode as watched at
accounts.progress_at_hint: Share of the episode you have to watch.
accounts.write_back_hint: Off: the lists only come from AniList / MAL and changes stay on this PC.
accounts.primary_hint: Its score scale is used when both are connected.
accounts.history_note: Watch history is not part of the account: it stays on this PC and syncs with your phone over Tatakai Link.
accounts.first.title: First sync with {service}
accounts.first.body: How should your list on this PC and your {service} list come together?
accounts.first.import_hint: Bring your {service} list here; where they differ, {service} wins.
accounts.first.export_hint: Send the list on this PC to {service}; where they differ, this PC wins.
accounts.first.merge_hint: Combine both and review the titles that differ.
accounts.error.no_client_id: This build has no {service} client id. Set {var} when building (register your own OAuth app; one per platform).
accounts.error.port: No free local port (47410-47430) for the sign-in callback. Close the app using it and try again.
accounts.error.browser: Could not open the browser for the sign-in.
accounts.error.timeout: The sign-in took too long. Try again.
accounts.error.denied: The sign-in was cancelled in the browser.
accounts.error.state: The sign-in answer did not match this request (invalid state). Try again.
accounts.error.invalid_callback: The service sent an incomplete answer. Try again.
accounts.error.exchange: The service refused the sign-in code. Try again.
accounts.error.expired: The session expired or was revoked. Connect the account again.
